_comment: Dungeon Level catalog (real data drives the schema). A Dungeon Level is one floor of an authored Dungeon: id, display name, depth (1-indexed; level 1 is the entrance floor), and the Map id whose grid is rendered when the party is on this level. Levels are referenced in order from a Dungeon's `levels[]` array. Catalog ships empty. See docs/data_dictionary/dungeon_level.md.
